fusions.name: Braided Towline
fusions.desc: Cracks a braided towline at a target up to 6 tiles away. It deals 18 damage, up to 1.5 times that at the far end of its reach, and uses up every affliction you have on the target for 60% more damage each.

fusions.name: Tangling Spokes
fusions.desc: Your wheels fling loose strands at every enemy within 2.5 tiles. It deals 4 damage, with a 30% chance to leave each enemy [Slowed] for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Drag Rigging
fusions.desc: Strings a net of strands 6 tiles long ahead of you for 5 seconds, dragging every enemy near it inward.

fusions.name: Tangled Reins
fusions.desc: Each time you inflict a condition on an enemy, your next spell deals 15% more damage. Once every 6 seconds.
